protocol.description: Varuna's shell asks varuna-compositor to draw pieces of liquid glass behind its layer surfaces: the live screen behind each piece, blurred and refracted. The pieces are part of the surface's state, so they move with its content on the same frame.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Glass objects already made stay valid.

request.name: get_glass
request.description: Make the glass object for a layer surface. A surface has at most one.

entry.name: already_has_glass
entry.summary: the surface already has a glass object

interface.name: varuna_glass_v1
interface.description: All state is double-buffered: it applies on the next wl_surface.commit. Until then the pieces already applied keep being drawn.

entry.name: veil
entry.summary: clear glass under a white veil

entry.name: bar
entry.summary: always frosted, for the menu bar

entry.name: liquid
entry.summary: a drop, pulled out as it moves

entry.name: backdrop
entry.summary: the screen out of focus, dimmed

request.name: destroy
request.description: The glass goes with the surface's next commit.

request.name: set_look
request.description: Lifted pieces cast a deeper shadow.

request.name: set_pieces
request.description: The pieces, surface-local logical pixels: per piece x, y, width, height, corner radius, tint (0xrrggbb, or -1 for none) and, for a liquid drop, its stretch along x and y in thousandths. An empty array clears the glass.

arg.name: pieces
arg.summary: int32 x8 per piece; geometry in 1/256 px
